title: NoWorld: False Horizon — Live Playability Roadmap

policy.authority: User is sole phone gameplay acceptance authority; gates can report implementation/build evidence and request phone test, never self-accept on user's behalf.
policy.completed: A milestone is complete only if it integrates the real system/subsystem in the game, has real source/commit/build proof, and user confirms phone gameplay when applicable.
policy.counting: No tasks smaller than an integrated system or subsystem; source-only files/tests and packaging receipts never imply completion.
policy.platform: Phone-first, GitHub-first. PC only for actual Unreal, Koikatsu, Blender, Gaea, compilation or required testing.
policy.gates: Gate10 dismissed. Gate12 alone implements premium native UI from accepted nine-scope references and gacha-quality benchmarks. Gate09 dismissed; Gate11 retired.
policy.canon: Base + Alter/Awakened/Berserker + exceptional Grand Convergence; no fifth ordinary lineage.

milestones.title: Offline mobile startup and free World entry
milestones.acceptance: Native Android app launches offline, provides existing opening/Ruler/World flow without compulsory opening combat; real World entry works on the owner's phone.

milestones.title: Playable character movement, camera and touch traversal
milestones.acceptance: Approved real character is controllable using phone touch, camera, facing, ground movement, jump, swim and flight when available; anatomy-specific motion is applied in the real World.

milestones.title: Rendered real World battle and autonomous opponent turns
milestones.acceptance: Real player and opponent rigs visibly alternate decisions/actions, change genuine HP/status, react and resolve win/loss within the actual World, not a test runner.

milestones.title: Five-form original Luminous rigs, wardrobes and transformations
milestones.acceptance: Base, Alter, Awakened, Berserker and Grand Convergence use source-faithful real playable models, original wardrobes, facial morphs and transformations on the phone; no fifth ordinary lineage.

milestones.title: Shared authentic animation and expression runtime
milestones.acceptance: Native source-derived animations actually drive real gameplay traversal, combat, facial expression, anatomy/wardrobe and state transitions via a shared semantic rig resolver.

milestones.title: Exact approved five-form v4 combat kits
milestones.acceptance: All 45 approved core active/passive skills, nine Ultimate branches and five Fantasms apply actual v4 effects using existing two executors; all-field AoE and true costs, QTE, statuses work.

milestones.title: Weapons, projectiles, physical hits and combat VFX
milestones.acceptance: Native weapon/magic families, collisions, hit contact, reactions, ability cues, Fantasm presentation and combat effects visibly match source-authentic character actions.

milestones.title: Character identity, Versions and individual Manifestations
milestones.acceptance: Canonical Identity, four conventional Version kits plus exceptional Grand, distinct independently owned Manifestation instances, duplicates and roster selection work without character chips.

milestones.title: Premium native in-World interface and combat HUD
milestones.acceptance: Gate12 integrates polished gacha-grade Unreal native UI based on accepted nine-scope references: World/Ruler navigation, action selection, HP/status, targeting, battle results, authentic character visuals.

milestones.title: Persistent offline profile and local save/load
milestones.acceptance: World, roster, transformations, progression, wallet, possessions and decisions persist across real app exits/restarts using safe canonical SQLite identities and migrations.

milestones.title: First World terrain, deterministic streaming and navigation
milestones.acceptance: The real coherent 100×100 km first World has functioning Landscape/World Partition/PCG navigation and persistent seeded streaming around the accepted source anchors.

milestones.title: World landmarks, geography, settlements and interiors
milestones.acceptance: Citadel, towns, farmlands, roads, water, forest, caves, interiors and authored locations have original painterly-anime PBR quality, navigation/collision and playable interactions.

milestones.title: Ecology, resources, water and environmental simulation
milestones.acceptance: Persistent biome ecology, gatherable resources, water/terrain effects, wildlife, time and relevant environmental variation function as integrated simulation rather than scenery only.

milestones.title: Enemy AI, high-rank combat and encounter balancing
milestones.acceptance: Enemies make differentiated world/battle decisions, use authentic capabilities, varied ranks/telegraphs and relevant counterplay; no arbitrary global level scaling.

milestones.title: GP, domains and high-rank progression rules
milestones.acceptance: Exact approved GP strength, one strongest eligible Manifestation per identity, realm links, controlled territories, large-number safe rank math and Grand Convergence rules function in combat and save.

milestones.title: Rarity banners, weighted gacha, pity and atomic pulling
milestones.acceptance: Actually eligible accepted character banners, rare/featured odds, 10-pull floor, pity/guarantee, tickets, earned currency, atomic idempotent pulls and distinct duplicates work offline.

milestones.title: Inventory, anatomical storage and equipped gear
milestones.acceptance: Stack/provenance inventory, real anatomy-dependent physical capacity, functional equipment/weapon slots, appearance and item ownership operate consistently during exploration and combat.

milestones.title: Loot, rewards, consumables and earned currency
milestones.acceptance: Real World encounters/resources and quests grant legitimate items/currency/rewards; food/consumables have functional consequences and change retained inventory/wallet.

milestones.title: Crafting, invention, enhancement, durability and repairs
milestones.acceptance: Approved original recipes/materials/invention, crafting, equipment improvement, wear/durability and repair consume/produce actual persistent items with gameplay effects.

milestones.title: Settlement trade, markets and regional economics
milestones.acceptance: Authored merchant/market inventories, pricing, regional resources and causal settlement trade actually affect currency, NPCs and persistent World supply.

milestones.title: Character growth, affinity, proficiency and statistics
milestones.acceptance: Rank/experience, rarity, skills, proficiency, affinity, derived stats and equipment changes affect real gameplay with consistent persistence and no fabricated ownership.

milestones.title: Premium roster, character details and wardrobe UI
milestones.acceptance: Native user-quality roster, character Version details, full 2D/3D presentation, wardrobe, progression and equipment screens integrate real data and preserve accepted visual direction.

milestones.title: Premium home, gacha, records and territory UI
milestones.acceptance: Gate12 builds refined responsive premium native Home, Records, Gacha, Territory, opening/icons/rarities and coherent mobile navigation based on accepted art plus relevant gacha-quality conventions.

milestones.title: Native NPC life, relationships and faction systems
milestones.acceptance: Physical NPCs with schedules, ecology, dialogue context, relationships, factions, deaths/absence and causal persistent population/world reactions act within the real World.

milestones.title: Branching quests, story events and consequences
milestones.acceptance: Authentic user-approved lore and playable non-forced open-World quests/dialogue branch on choices, race/species/context and update real characters, factions, rewards and World state.

milestones.title: Chronicle, Codex, knowledge and narrative memory
milestones.acceptance: Player knowledge, Chronicle, Codex and time-based missed-events record actual world/quest events without spoilers or simulated general autobiographical memory.

milestones.title: Bosses, optional encounters and dungeon progression
milestones.acceptance: Optional authored world encounters, real high-rank boss phases, persistent dungeons/events and meaningful victory/retreat/missed-event outcomes are playable without forced opening encounters.

milestones.title: Territories, Ruler powers and changing civilization
milestones.acceptance: Ruler mode, influence/domains, land control, governance/factions and persistent territorial consequences visibly change settlements, GP and game actions.

milestones.title: Synchronized source-authentic multi-participant interactions
milestones.acceptance: Real compatible participant rigs and semantically approved synchronized source animations execute in-game with reliable role/clock/contact/privacy/state; architecture supports up to 13 roles where genuinely sourced.

milestones.title: Adaptive music, original audio and game-event SFX
milestones.acceptance: Original licensed/owned soundtrack and approved Japanese vocal cues when sourced, adaptive stems, ambience, authentic hit/interface/world sound events and mixes function in actual gameplay.

milestones.title: Character and environmental visual polish
milestones.acceptance: Original accepted painterly-anime PBR art direction, skin/hair/cloth physics, morphological fidelity, light/VFX readability and atmosphere visibly hold in the actual mobile-rendered game.

milestones.title: Persistent events, migration and recovery integrity
milestones.acceptance: Offline save migration, consistent atomic transactions, recovery snapshots and safe resume protect real Manifestations, quests, World changes, items and user data after app restart/crash.

milestones.title: Mobile settings, touch ergonomics and accessibility
milestones.acceptance: Functional touch sizing, scalable UI, portrait/landscape where required, graphics/audio options, language/settings, legibility and accessibility behave correctly in the native phone app.

milestones.title: Android packaging, performance and device-ready delivery
milestones.acceptance: Current installable Android build packages authentic assets, uses viable memory/rendering/streaming/performance, survives lifecycle transitions and is handed to the owner for direct phone gameplay testing.

milestones.title: Windows standalone parity and reproducible native packaging
milestones.acceptance: Current standalone Windows release builds from production code with the full World, native UI, correct assets and save compatibility; compilation alone cannot close mobile gameplay acceptance.

milestones.title: Complete integrated full-game phone acceptance
milestones.acceptance: Owner plays current Android release through open World, all forms, combat, quests, NPCs, economy, gacha, interactions, UI, persistence, visuals and audio and explicitly confirms the complete approved playable game.
